tool.name: DragonClaw简介
tool.description: 一款端到端的质量运营与风险管理工作台，通过自动化采集、规则引擎合控、AI 辅助分析及智能提醒，实现从风险发现到闭环复盘的全链路自动化，帮助团队从繁琐的搬运工作中解放出来，专注于决策与教练工作。
tool.descriptionEn: An end-to-end quality operations and risk management workspace that automates the entire lifecycle from data collection and rule-based analysis to AI-driven insights and intelligent alerts, enabling teams to shift from manual data handling to high-value decision-making and coaching.
